entities.summary: Giuseppe Penone is an Italian artist and sculptor, known for his large-scale sculptures of trees. He is interested in the link between man and the natural world. His early work is often associated with the Arte povera movement. In 2014, Penone was awarded the prestigious Praemium Imperiale award. He currently lives and works in Turin, Italy. Giuseppe Penone was a authors & novelists from Garessio (b. 1947-04-03, Garessio). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
